architecture_decisions: Disposable candidate validation will use the validation profile selected from the authoritative accepted-source workspace before candidate mutation.
validations: Candidate validation path currently copies the authoritative workspace, safely applies the non-authoritative proposal, then asks the authoritative accepted/base workspace for the validation profile. The resulting immutable `ValidationProfile` is passed explicitly into disposable candidate validation.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — The workstream records the exact deployment, successful resume/source reads, Luna/Terra completion and `DISPOSABLE_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION / VALUE_CONTRACT_ERROR` diagnostic.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — Production candidate validation selects the profile from `base_workspace` before applying candidate edits.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — The Vercel candidate validator uses the supplied immutable profile instead of calling `select_validation_profile()` on candidate-mutated source.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — A candidate that adds/removes profile marker files does not change the selected profile ID, commands, dependency policy or execution-snapshot family.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — The candidate content digest/files/bytes and actual BUILD/TEST/VERIFY operate on the mutated disposable candidate, not the base workspace.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — If accepted source has no admitted profile, candidate validation fails before candidate mutation/sandbox execution.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — Profile/policy exceptions map to fixed `VALIDATION_PROFILE_ERROR`; raw exception text is absent from durable and operational diagnostics.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — SafeImplementationEngine, source lineage, evaluation, Git/deployment/lifecycle, human REVIEW, model roster, timeout, hidden retry, candidate recovery and final repair ceilings are unchanged.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Focused tests, full API regression, applicable client checks, protected promotion evaluation, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and required DSPy compile/verify are green on the exact reviewed head.
AC-10: validate protected requirement — The exact merged application source reaches READY on the production API; `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 and runtime verification is clean.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — A signed-in retry of Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` or equivalent exact work enters disposable BUILD/TEST/VERIFY under the accepted-source pinned profile, or exposes a later bounded blocker with server-owned diagnostics.
risks: No disposable BUILD/TEST/VERIFY sandbox followed that admission failure. The candidate validation path currently copies the authoritative workspace, safely applies the non-authoritative proposal, then asks the authoritative accepted/base workspace for the validation profile. The resulting immutable `ValidationProfile` is passed explicitly into disposable candidate validation.
